stem:
Vivek leaves half his lunch on the plate though he had asked for a full serving.

Why should he try not to waste food?

options.text: Regions that offer fewer kinds of food show more respect for farmers.
Farmers and others put time and effort into bringing food from farm to plate, so food should be respected.
It is fine to waste food when it is cheap.
Wasting food is mainly a problem only in restaurants, not at school.

teacher.key_rationale: Avoiding waste respects the time and effort of farmers and community members who bring food from farm to plate. Variety of foods and low price do not remove that duty.
